data.one_liner: Builder that generates dart_mappable code for JSON serialization and data classes.
data.what_it_does: Generates mapping code for classes annotated with @MappableClass, handling generics, inheritance, and primary constructors. It integrates with build_runner to produce efficient, type‑safe serializers.
use_when: You need compile‑time JSON (de)serialization with support for generics and inheritance.
You want a code‑gen alternative to manual toJson/fromJson implementations.
You prefer a single annotation‑based approach over multiple boilerplate files.
avoid_when: You prefer a runtime‑only solution without build steps.
Your project cannot add build_runner or code‑gen dependencies.
strengths: Full support for generics, inheritance and primary constructors
Fast runtime performance because code is generated
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation step
Only works for Dart (no native platform plugins)
data.setup_notes: Add dart_mappable_builder to dev_dependencies, configure build_runner, and run `flutter pub run build_runner build`.

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides annotation‑based JSON serialization with json_serializable, a widely used alternative.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Generates immutable data classes and JSON support via freezed, also uses build_runner.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers immutable value types with serialization, suitable for complex models.
